palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search and jump to any area

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Move around Turing without leaving the keyboard.
shortcuts.dismiss: Close the palette or a dialog

rail.title: One rail, three hubs
rail.body: The left rail keeps just Home and the three hubs — Generative AI, Enterprise Search, and Management. Everything else lives one tap inside its hub.

palette.title: Jump anywhere with the palette
palette.body: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) from any screen to search and jump straight to any area. Press ? any time to see every shortcut.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.body: On any list, Customize layout lets you drag tiles to reorder them and pick their size. Your arrangement sticks across sessions.

layout.editHint: Drag tiles to reorder · pick S / M / L to resize
